drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We can move toward your proposal on both termination protection and post-employment restrictions. The attached draft offers a $475,000 Base Salary and extends severance to a resignation for Good Reason, subject to notice and an opportunity to cure. It replaces the non-compete with confidentiality and a 12-month non-solicitation covenant. We have proposed 12 months of salary continuation and benefits rather than 24 months; please let us know whether this framework works as a basis to close the remaining points.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual Base Salary of $475,000, payable in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices, plus benefits under the Company's applicable benefit plans.
edits.name: Base Salary

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive without Cause, or the Executive resigns for Good Reason, the Company shall continue the Executive's Base Salary for 12 months and provide continued participation in its group health benefits for that period, subject to applicable plan terms and law. Good Reason means a material reduction in Base Salary or a material diminution in the Executive's duties or authority, provided the Executive gives written notice within 30 days after the event, the Company has 30 days to cure, and the Executive resigns within 30 days after the cure period expires. Severance is subject to the Executive's execution of a customary release of claims.
edits.name: Severance and Good Reason

edits.text: 4. CONFIDENTIALITY; NON-SOLICITATION. The Executive shall not use or disclose the Company's nonpublic confidential information except as required to perform the Executive's duties or as permitted by law. For 12 months after employment ends, the Executive shall not directly solicit Company employees with whom the Executive worked materially during the preceding 12 months to leave the Company, or directly solicit Company customers with whom the Executive had material business contact during that period to cease or materially reduce their business with the Company. General advertisements not targeted at those persons are not prohibited. Nothing in this section restricts lawful whistleblowing or other legally protected disclosures.
edits.name: Post-employment restrictions
